name: Aptiv
description: Aptiv designs and builds the connectors, wiring, sensors, computers and software inside vehicles and sells them to the automakers themselves: its customers include the 25 largest OEMs, and its products were in 18 of the 20 top-selling US models in 2025. It typically supplies through purchase orders under each OEM's general terms, with contractual price reductions and commodity (copper) costs passed through, so revenue tracks how many vehicles the customer builds. Ten customers were 56 percent of 2025 sales and one about 10 percent. On April 1, 2026 Aptiv spun off its largest and lowest-margin business, Electrical Distribution Systems (43 percent of FY2025 segment sales, 12.2 percent gross margin), as Versigent (NYSE: VGNT). Two segments remain: Engineered Components (connectors and cable protection, also sold to aerospace, defense and telecom) and Intelligent Systems (safety sensors, compute and software).

gics.note: The Wikipedia list gives only GICS sector and sub-industry; industry group and industry are not in that source and are left null, not filled from memory. SEC SIC code from the EDGAR submissions record: 3714 Motor Vehicle Parts & Accessories.

hq.note: Spitalstrasse 5, 8200 Schaffhausen (FY2025 10-K cover, which also lists Jersey as jurisdiction of incorporation); Aptiv PLC is the parent after a December 2024 reorganization

employees.note: About 140,000 people (30,000 salaried, 110,000 hourly) plus about 51,000 contingent workers, FY2025 10-K. Includes the Electrical Distribution Systems business spun off 2026-04-01, so the current count is lower and not yet filed.

businessLines.name: Electrical Distribution Systems (spun off 2026-04-01 as Versigent PLC; discontinued operations from Q2 2026)
businessLines.how: Sold per unit to automakers under purchase orders for specific vehicle programs, with commodity cost (copper) passed through and contractual price reductions; the lowest gross margin of the three segments. No longer part of Aptiv after 2026-04-01.
businessLines.description: Low- and high-voltage power, signal and data distribution solutions; the largest segment in FY2025.

businessLines.name: Engineered Components (formerly Engineered Components Group)
businessLines.how: Parts sold per unit under OEM purchase orders and to non-automotive customers; the highest gross margin of the three segments.
businessLines.description: Connection systems, high-performance interconnects and cable management and protection for automotive and for aerospace and defense, telecom and datacom, and industrial customers.

businessLines.name: Intelligent Systems (formerly Advanced Safety and User Experience)
businessLines.how: Sensors, compute platforms and software/services sold to automakers under OEM programs; FY2025 adjusted operating income fell $56M from $714M.
businessLines.description: Active Safety, User Experience and Smart Vehicle Compute and Software product lines: intelligent sensors, high-performance compute platforms, and software and services.

brands.name: Versigent (NYSE: VGNT)
brands.note: Spun-off Electrical Distribution Systems business. Aptiv shareholders received one Versigent share per three Aptiv shares (record date 2026-03-17); Aptiv received a $1,920M cash dividend from Versigent and transferred $282M cash to it (Q2 2026 10-Q cash flow statement).
